text:
sam: FYI I put up a prototype dashboard for warmstart forecasting + SLI tuning -> https://dash.redwood/warmstart-forecast (clickable). It aggregates per-model-family hit-rate projections, token-saved forecasts, and suggested alert thresholds based on the last 7d of data. Looking for quick runtime/observability eyes. :eyes:

jia: Nice! Quick question — can we surface kernel-selection breakdowns? We saw the hit-rate swing a few days ago that lined up with the `kernels/v2` rollout. That slice would be helpful.

omar: Also add batching-heuristic buckets (seq len percentiles/bins). The forecasting math assumes current batching behavior; if we change bin boundaries the predicted token savings shift nonlinearly.

perf-bot: profiling-job: warmstart-v2 completed -> summary:
```
model: model-x
scenario: kv-prefetch-prime
delta: 99p latency -8% (p50 ~ -2%)
kv-hit-rate bump: +12ppt
notes: hotspot on kv-lookup kernel reduced time by ~14% per call
```

sam: Good catch. Action items I propose: 1) add kernel & batching slices to the dashboard (per-model family + per-route), 2) add a normalized token-saved SLI (tokens_saved_per_1k_requests), 3) new alert candidate: sustained drop >= 5ppt in hit-rate over 24h => page. Also call out regressions from last kernel rollout (r1234) that caused ~3ppt hit-rate drop for model-y.

jia: I'll take the DQL to pull per-tenant and per-route slices and add a chart for top-10 tenants (they're ~62% of total saved tokens). Will also compute token-saved normalized by route weight.

omar: I'll add batching distribution panels and a toggle to simulate bin shifts (so we can see forecast sensitivity). Also we should expose the warmup priming TTL used in the projection (currently 6h) so PMs can tweak it.

sam: Perfect. One more: include a small panel that shows recent kernel rollouts and a diff of hit-rate pre/post (last 48h) — helps correlate. If anyone sees a regression signal that's >3ppt for a model family, put it in the 'investigate' lane.

perf-bot: added alert stub: `warmstart.hitrate.drop` -> conditions: hit_rate_drop_pct >= 5 for 24h, scope: model_family OR route, notify: #eng-oncall + runtime-oncall.

jia: Sounds good. I'll PR the dashboard JSON + the DQL queries by EOD. If we want, we can run a backtest against last 30d to validate the forecasting logic before enabling alerts.

sam: Backtest would be ideal. Thanks all — let's iterate quickly, want alerts gated until backtest passes and PM signoff. :thumbsup:
